feeds.title: University of Washington Botanic Gardens Blog
feeds.description: University of Washington Botanic Gardens has a mission to sustain managed natural ecosystems and the human spirit through plant research, display, and education. At the University of Washington Botanic Gardens, they value and honor diverse experiences and perspectives, strive to create a welcoming and respectful learning environment and promote access, fairness, and opportunity for all. Go through their blog and read about their garden, and their events, along with informative articles on the garden.

feeds.title: The Garden Glove
feeds.description: We're Steve & Kathy Bates, and here we are juggling three blogs together, sharing the best of the DIY and decorating world that we can, and trying to get a few projects of our own out there from time to time! Browse The Garden Glove for tons of creative DIY projects, ideas & tips on gardening, plants, backyard decorating, and outdoor spaces!

feeds.title: Seattle Japanese Garden Blog
feeds.description: Open to the public since June 1960, Seattle Japanese Garden is one of the most highly regarded Japanese-style gardens in North America. Tucked within a vast arboretum in a fast-growing city, the garden attracts over 100,000 visitors annually and is beloved both locally and by garden-lovers from over 30 countries around the world.

feeds.title: Dirt Therapy
feeds.description: Follow Dirt Therapy by Phillip Oliver to learn new tips, tricks, and information on gardening.

feeds.title: Sky Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Key topics covered in Sky Nursery's blog are Edible Gardening, Garden Science, Indoor Gardening, Jr. Gardeners, and more. Whether you're a gardener of 30 years or 30 minutes, Sky Nursery in North Seattle has everything you need. Offering great plants & expertise since 1953.

feeds.title: Floret Flowers Blog
feeds.description: We cover a range of topics, including flower farming, flower workshops, farm tours, cut flower crops, and more. We are a family-run flower farm located in Washington's Skagit Valley, specializing in growing unique, uncommon, and heirloom flowers. Our thriving research and education farm is dedicated to giving flower lovers the tools and information they need to grow the gardens of their dreams.

feeds.title: Susan's in the Garden Blog
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Susan Mulvihill and I am passionate about gardening. I am based in Spokane, Wash., where my husband and I garden on 5 acres. I've been writing garden columns for the Sunday edition of The Spokesman-Review newspaper for many years. It is my belief that everyone should be able to grow a garden, and toward that end, I've dedicated this website, my columns, and my life to teaching others how to do just that!

feeds.title: Bellevue Botanical Garden
feeds.description: Latest news from the Bellevue Botanical Garden. The Bellevue Botanical Garden Society works in partnership with the City of Bellevue to achieve the Garden's mission. Our role is to raise funds, support the Garden's physical growth and development, and provide a broad range of programs and events designed to engage, inspire and inform Garden visitors.

feeds.title: Sunnyside Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Steve Smith's weekly gardening column will impart timely gardening advice sprinkled with a bit of humor. Sunnyside Nursery is a garden center for all your landscaping essentials with a friendly, knowledgeable staff. We're a small, local business and support the same in our community.

feeds.title: Watson's Greenhouse Blog
feeds.description: Watson's has been a Puyallup Valley staple for over 25 years. Helping people grow their space through providing quality plants and products for the home.

feeds.title: Derby Canyon Natives Blog
feeds.description: Derby Canyon Natives, located along the Wenatchee River near Peshastin, WA, is a specialty nursery growing wildflowers, grasses, shrubs, and trees native to Central Washington. Since 2002 we have provided container-grown plants produced from seeds and cuttings collected from the region's varied habitats, including shrub-steppe, forest, and riparian zones.

feeds.title: Vander Giessen Nursery, Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Trusted Knowledge & Inspiration to Help Your Garden Thrive. Since 1938, Vander Giessen Nursery has provided Lynden and greater Whatcom County top-quality hanging baskets, annuals, perennials, shrubs and trees. Trust your gardening needs to us!

feeds.title: Garden Washington Blog
feeds.description: Need to know what to plant? When to plant? How to plant? Where to find great plants? We've got you covered & are here to help you be successful! GardenWashington is part of a national initiative to educate people about the benefits of plants and trees, inspiring them to plant more in an effort to improve our environment, health and communities.

feeds.title: West Seattle Blog » Gardening
feeds.description: The West Seattle Blog is a community news website that covers local news, events, and happenings in the West Seattle area. The site features a variety of content, including breaking news, spotlight stories, and information on local politics and safety.

feeds.title: Swansons Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Read articles and resources on gardening, container gardenings, garden design, and more. Swansons Nursery is Seattle's Favorite Garden Store Since 1924. They have since grown into a modern, urban garden center, still locally-owned, still focused on giving you the same service and expertise.

feeds.title: Kruckeberg Botanic Garden Blog
feeds.description: Get news from Kruckeberg Botanic Garden.The Kruckeberg Botanic Garden in Shoreline, Washington, is a public garden rich in native plants of the Pacific Northwest and unusual species from other lands, set in a wooded, park-like atmosphere.

feeds.title: Green Gardening With Ann Lovejoy
feeds.description: For many years, I wrote gardening and cooking columns for Seattle newspapers and national magazines, many of which are sadly gone. My life has also changed and I no longer travel or lecture widely but stay close to home to care for family members with health issues. My garden has altered as well, yet it remains a comfort, inspiration, and great pleasure to me. Though change is inevitable, I am delighted to be sharing my experiences, ideas, and recipes once again through the Log House Plants gardening community.

feeds.title: My Secret Garden
feeds.description: Find posts on Garden and travel-related stories, interpretative reviews of tour gardens, garden, and travel photography.

feeds.title: Garden Spot Nursery Blog
feeds.description: The Garden Spot was founded by Marcy Plattner over 35 years ago and has been a Bellingham staple and a gathering place for friends and gardeners. Garden Spot Nursery blog offers amazing articles on plants, trees, shrubs, pottery, gardening tools, potting soil, fertilizers, wind chimes, fairy garden supplies, and more.

feeds.title: Notes From The Tomato Lady Blog
feeds.description: Musings from the garden. We are a local urban farm interested in promoting growing your own garden. We also believe in educating people on how, why, and where to grow.

feeds.title: Venture Out Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Venture Out Nursery was conceived by owners Garth and Molly Heggenes, and Chris and Tina Joselyn as a way to demonstrate their beautiful and unique landscape designs. Rather than relying on computer programs or sketches to show what a landscape would look like, they created a nursery with real examples of beautiful Pacific Northwest gardens. We offer a wide variety of plants, from large specimens to tiny treasures.

feeds.title: A Transplanted Gardener
feeds.description: A Transplanted Gardener blog is about a Master Gardener from Northern New England who moves to the Pacific Northwest. His blog articles are about his accumulated gardening experiences encountered along the way.

feeds.title: Backyard Gardener
feeds.description: Backyard Gardener provides gardening tips on 33000 plants, with guidance on how to grow. Whether you are interested in flowers, plants, trees, organic gardening, vegetable gardening, lawn, herb gardening, they have it all.

feeds.title: Squak Mt. Greenhouses & Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Join the dialog with our friendly, knowledgeable team at Squak Mt. Greenhouses and Nursery. We make regular entries to this gardening diary every week to keep you updated on what we are growing in our greenhouses. Squak Mt. Greenhouses and Nursery have grown up in the beautiful Tibbetts Creek Valley of Issaquah, Washington. From a mainly wholesale growing operation specializing in fuchsias and house plants, it has blossomed into a complete retail garden center serving the greater Seattle area.

feeds.title: The Seattle Times » Garden
feeds.description: Find gardening advice, learn about plants, and keep up with news and events from the world of gardening. The Seattle Times is a locally-owned, independent news source. We're known for our comprehensive local coverage that creates conversation within the Seattle community, throughout the nation and around the globe.
